the microwave absorption of Ba0.4Sr0.6Co2InFe10O19 is enhanced by increasing the thickness of the sample, and the absorption peak frequency is shifted towards lower frequencies with increasing thickness.
the electromagnetic absorption in hexaferrite compositions is enhanced by increasing Co2+-In 3+ substitution.
the Co2+-In 3+ ions are responsible for enhanced absorption in the hexaferrite composition.

a novel class of microwave absorbers based on the Ba0.5SrxCo1−xInxFe12O19 ferrites, and we believe this will be of great interest to the researchers in this area.
the design, synthesis, and characterization of a novel microwave absorber based on Ba0.5SrxCo2xInxFe12-2xO19 (x = 0–1) hexaferrites.
the electromagnetic absorption of Ba0.50Sr0.50CoxInx Fe12−2x O19 hexaferrites.

the present compositions can be used for the fabrication of electromagnetic absorbers in the frequency band 8.2–12.4 GHz.
the electromagnetic absorption properties of the ferrite compositions were enhanced with the substitution of Co and In in the hexaferrite compositions.
the Co2+ and/or In3+ substitution is a promising approach to enhance the electromagnetic absorption in Ba0.5S0.5Fe12−2O19 ferrites for microwave absorber applications.

the microwave absorption properties of Ba1-xCoxFe12O19 and Ba0.5InxFe11.5O19 hexafarrites were reported in our recent work [1, 2].
the ferrites can be used as an effective absorber in the microwave region.

the electromagnetic absorption properties can be tuned by the proper substitution of Co2+–In3+ ions in Ba0.5 Sr0.5Fe12O19 ferrites.
